reviews.text: Melodi treated our little Moose as if he was one of her own pups.  The haircut was perfect.  Moose will be a regular.

The staff at Blue Bubble Spa are great. We’ve taken our pup to a few different groomers over the past four years and this place tops them all.

They truly care about your animal and go above and beyond to make sure they’re comfortable before any service starts. They earn your dog’s trust and get her at ease first, then move forward with the grooming without stressing her out.

What sold me was that they checked on her wellbeing before grooming. They explained that too much stress during grooming can trigger a seizure or other health issues in a dog, and told me up front they wouldn’t charge me a cent if they felt she was too anxious to bathe safely. Most places would have just pushed through to get paid.

Melodi was patient, honest, and clearly knows what she’s doing. Highly recommend them to anyone with a nervous or sensitive dog.

Melody is an amazing groomer and a true dog whisperer! Her genuine connection with our dogs is undeniable, and they feel completely comfortable with her. They always come home looking fantastic and happy. We highly recommend her!

Melody was absolutely amazing with my 12 year old golden retriever. He has mobility issues yet she had no problem grooming him and being patient with him. I’ve never had such a lovely experience with any other groomer before. I’ll definitely be bringing my dog back to her!

Blue Bubbles is great! We always board our dogs there and it is the only place where they run inside and don't look back at us when they are dropped off. The team is very responsive and we  get daily video updates. We never feel guilty leaving them.
Melodi and her mom where awesome with our fur babies
Melody is very patient inconsiderate of the pups comfort
Melodi is the best! Bring your dog one time for a grooming and your dog will want to come back.
Went for the first time. They really try to make your dog feel relaxed and comfortable.
Happiest place in the world. My golden Arlo who can be timid is completely at home with Melody and her babies.

First time at Blue Bubbles and I absolutely loved the experience. From the moment we arrived, she took the time to ask thoughtful questions to truly understand both my needs and Rex’s needs. You can tell she genuinely cares about the dogs and wants them to feel comfortable and safe. Rex was treated with so much patience and kindness I felt confident leaving him there. We’ll definitely be back!
Always a great experience with Melodi!
Loved it! We’ll be back ☺️
We've been taking our dog, George, here for a while now. Great owners that take great care of your dog. Definitely recommend this place for anyone in the hood.

Melodi is hands down the best groomer my little Maltese, Brody, has ever had and we went through quite a few until we finally found Blue Bubbles in 2021. I can honestly say I won’t trust anyone else with him ever again. Melodi truly cares about animals and always puts their well-being first. One time she even called me to let me know that Brody just wasn’t feeling it that day but left the decision up to me. Of course, I went to pick him up lol, but that just showed how much she genuinely looks out for her furry clients. Brody always looks amazing after seeing her and comes home happy. If you’re looking for a groomer who treats your baby like her own Melodi is the one!

Melody and her Mother were very welcoming, friendly and loving to our Dog Bean!
The facility is very c lean and well taken care of.
This has been the most immaculate hair cut and baths Bean has ever gotten.
We’ll be back soon!

Melodi was so sweet to our dog. First time boarding experience and it couldn't have been better. You can she truly cares about the  dogs under her care. She even spends the night there if she's boarding dogs!

The facility itself is super cute and clean. Lots of indoor and outdoor play areas with turf. Large rooms for social dogs. And individual kennels for the ones that like to be solo. We were afraid our dog wouldn't want to come back with us!!! 🐾

They are so nice and kind with dogs 🥰
The owner , Melodi is a real dog lover and , she treats them like a Doll 😇, I highly recommend them as the best in Houston . …
We love Blue Bubbles! Our doggies jump for joy when they see Melody! And they always look beautiful afterwards!

Absolutely the best groomer I have ever had! I've had my Chow/Husky mix for almost 9 years. I have had MANY groomers. Melodie (the owner of Blue Bubble Spa) not only meets my hope and wishes for how I want my dog groomed, but she goes above and beyond to meet my dogs needs too. She's so gentle and patient with her. This means so mich since my dog has bad hips. Melodie and her mom are kind and loving. They clearly have a real drive to do right by our fur babies. Im a very skeptical person when it comes to trusting people with my pets and I have never once worried about leaving my babies with Melodie. Please know this is a very reliable and trustworthy establishment. Thank y'all for all you do for our fur babies! 🩵
Great

Melodi has lovingly taken care of grooming Paulie, our now 16 year old shitzu for years. However, on this most recent occasion, Blue Bubbles provided the Ritz Carlton treatment for a 10 nights stay when family was unavailable to look after Paulie and Melodi kindly sent us frequent videos to show him interacting with other spa “residents” and seemingly enjoying himself. In a couple of instances when Paulie didn’t eat his “favorite” food Melodi was able to coax him back to eating again with a quality alternative meal. In summary I would have no hesitation in recommending Bluebubbles

I am so happy that I found Blu Bubbles and Melody!  I had a terrible experience with a random groomer at one of the “chain store” groomers.  I looked up groomers that work with older dogs and Blue Bubbles popped up first!  I spoke Melody-owner who has an AWESOME personality and she asked to meet my lil man.  We met and he just loved her and she loved him too!  I scheduled a grooming appointment and she explained how it would all go which included every detail of her process.  I picked him up and he was happy (freshly groomed) and she said he did GREAT!  Thank GOD for BBS and Melody’s MAGIC TOUCH!
Melodi was very patient, caring and detail oriented grooming my three pomeranians. They all looked so clean, fresh and adorable. Thanks to all your hard work Melodi!
Melodie is great with my dog, he can be difficult to groom but she always is so sweet and loving to him.
Excellent treatment to my dog

Melodi was so kind and caring! She made me feel at ease going here for the first time!
She was so gentle with my puppy and was very attentive to my instructions on how I wanted her groomed. I will definitely be bringing my puppy back!

Melodi and Madonna are so good with  dogs and they take their time no rush job!They nearly took over an hour just to groom our dog who is a Shih Tzu 16 years old .So much of Patience  grooming him ,cleaning  his ears and his face cause he’s got a lot of hair and he can’t see and he can hear!!!
so it’s a challenge getting him cleaned up.💕
Hey Melody, thanks for your one on one care with Paulie . He appreciated it. He looks really clean and groom now.

Melodi is fabulous! She not only gives the best doodle cuts, but she loves her clients! I have one doodle who had a bad experience with a previous groomer and she loves Melodi! Melodi does not push her when she is. Not feeling and works with her mood. We love melodi & blue Bubbles spa!

Truly a five star business. We’ve used Melodi for grooming and boarding and have been so impressed. With grooming she does beautiful work and is so patient and loving with the process. We have an Australian Mountain Doodle and he always comes home looking so handsome! With boarding Melodi
goes above and beyond to make sure your fur baby is comfortable and happy. I’ve always felt guilty boarding my dogs at other places but not at Blue Bubbles! Highly recommend!

This is THE absolute BEST groomer for your fur baby! No one else is as understanding, sweet, willing to take things slow and let you bring your baby into the grooming area to help them get comfortable. You’ll have no worries here, they listen to all your concerns and truly adore every dog. 🥰 …
Love her. My dogs adore her. We have known Melodi for five years, and we love the new space!!

Best place for large breed dogs! Took my 185 pound Cane Corso there and he had the best experience. Easy in and out for the bathing sation and everything was clean. He doesn’t usually take to strangers but he loved the entire experience. Will return every month

My Lucy (Lucas terrier) has had the pleasure of Blue Bubbles “Royal Spa Days” for 8 years and counting.  Lucy hated it so much that she learned how the Mobile Grooming Palace sounded and when she heard it she’d run for the hills, she even …

I love this place, my little doggy loved the pampering they provided. She was treated like a true princess. I highly recommend this place. They are very attentive, kind, and caring for animals. The owners heart goes above and beyond to make you feel like home.
Melodi really cares about your pet and does a great job!

Melody has made our grooming experience with our Maltipoo, Beary who can be very anxious so pleasant. She is so patient and sweet to our puppy and we can't wait to take Beary back for his next appointment! I cannot recommend her enough!
